ruleset.name: Stratum Lombok
ruleset.description: Code that Stratum generates with Lombok instead of writing it by hand.

rule.name: UseLombokGetter
rule.message: Generate this getter with Lombok @Getter instead of writing it (ST-ENG-42).
rule.description: A getter that only returns a field of its class and is named as Lombok would name it, such as getName() or isActive(). An adapter such as getUsername() returning loginName is not reported.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration [parent::ClassBody[parent::ClassDeclaration[@Interface = false()]] or parent::EnumBody] [FormalParameters/@Size = 0] [Block/@Size = 1] [let $field := Block/ReturnStatement/(FieldAccess[ThisExpression] | VariableAccess)/@Name, $property := concat(upper-case(substring($field, 1, 1)), substring($field, 2)) return $field = ../FieldDeclaration[@Static = false()]/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name and @Name = (concat('get', $property), concat('is', $property))]

rule.name: UseLombokSetter
rule.message: Generate this setter with Lombok @Setter instead of writing it (ST-ENG-42).
rule.description: A setter that only assigns its parameter to a field of its class and is named as Lombok would name it, such as setName(String) for the field name.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration [parent::ClassBody[parent::ClassDeclaration[@Interface = false()]]] [FormalParameters/@Size = 1] [Block/@Size = 1] [let $assignment := Block/ExpressionStatement/AssignmentExpression[@Operator = '='], $field := $assignment/*[1][self::FieldAccess[ThisExpression] or self::VariableAccess]/@Name return $field = ../FieldDeclaration[@Static = false()]/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name and $assignment/*[2][self::VariableAccess]/@Name = FormalParameters/FormalParameter/VariableId/@Name and @Name = concat('set', upper-case(substring($field, 1, 1)), substring($field, 2))]

rule.name: UseLombokConstructor
rule.message: Generate this constructor with Lombok @RequiredArgsConstructor or @AllArgsConstructor instead of writing it (ST-ENG-42).
rule.description: A constructor that assigns each of its parameters, unchanged, to the field of the same name, and does nothing else. A constructor that sets several fields from one parameter is not reported.

rule.name: UseLombokEqualsAndHashCode
rule.message: Use a record, or Lombok @EqualsAndHashCode, instead of writing equals and hashCode (ST-ENG-40, ST-ENG-42).
rule.description: A hand-written equals(Object) or hashCode() in a class.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration [parent::ClassBody[parent::ClassDeclaration[@Interface = false()]]] [@Static = false()] [(@Name = 'equals' and FormalParameters/@Size = 1 and FormalParameters/FormalParameter/ClassType[@SimpleName = 'Object']) or (@Name = 'hashCode' and FormalParameters/@Size = 0)]

rule.name: UseLombokToString
rule.message: Use a record, or Lombok @ToString, instead of writing toString; leave out secrets and personal data with @ToString.Exclude (ST-ENG-42, ST-SEC-03).
rule.description: A hand-written toString() in a class. Enums may still override toString.

rule.name: UseLombokBuilder
rule.message: Generate this builder with Lombok @Builder instead of writing it (ST-ENG-42).
rule.description: A class named *Builder with a build() method, which neither extends nor implements another type. A class that implements a library's builder interface is not reported, nor a builder class that customizes the one Lombok generates for its enclosing type, such as a build() that validates.

rule.name: UseLombokLogger
rule.message: Declare the logger with Lombok @Slf4j instead of calling getLogger (ST-ENG-42).
rule.description: A logger field created by hand.
